task_completion.description: The Weasis medical viewer application is open and visible on the desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is active, showing the DICOM viewer interface.

task_completion.description: The CT scan (0002.DCM) is loaded into the viewer.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A medical image (CT/X-ray) is displayed in the central viewport of Weasis.

task_completion.description: A measurement line representing the long axis of a structure has been drawn.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A linear measurement tool is visible on the image with a numeric value and unit (e.g., mm).

task_completion.description: A second measurement line representing the perpendicular short axis has been drawn.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Two intersecting measurement lines are visible on the same anatomical structure, forming a cross-hair pattern.

task_completion.description: The agent exports or saves the viewer screenshot to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent interacts with a 'Save' or 'Export' dialog, or a terminal command confirms the creation of recist_annotation.png.

task_completion.description: A text report is created with the specific RECIST format and values.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows a file named recist_report.txt containing 'Long Axis:' and 'Short Axis:' with numeric values.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI tools to perform measurements rather than just writing a text file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the measurement tool icons in the Weasis toolbar.

integrity.description: The measurements in the report match the values visible on the Weasis screen.
integrity.visual_evidence: The numeric values in the final recist_report.txt correspond to the labels visible on the measurement lines in the Weasis viewer.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply move a pre-existing screenshot or report into the export folder.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the active process of drawing lines in the GUI and typing/saving the report.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target image is 0002.DCM. The agent must produce two files: a screenshot at ~/DICOM/exports/recist_annotation.png showing intersecting measurement lines, and a text file at ~/DICOM/exports/recist_report.txt. The report must strictly follow the format: 'Long Axis: <value>\nShort Axis: <value>'. The values in the text file must match the visual labels on the screenshot.
